create.title: Tuck a note into the {color} box.
create.intro: Write, attach, and encrypt in this browser. The server receives only an authenticated encrypted envelope and its lifecycle.
create.text_help: Text, formatting choice, and attachment details are encrypted together.
create.local_body: Your link secret and optional password are never uploaded.
create.expiry_help: The server converts this duration to the exact expiry used by encryption.
create.read_cap_help: One reveal is burn-after-reading. A reveal is consumed before local decryption.
create.password_help: The link stays bare: only this password can decrypt the note. Share it separately.
create.how_body: Nyanbin reserves an ID and exact lifecycle, encrypts locally with AES-256-GCM, binds that public policy as authenticated data, then uploads. Anyone with the complete link and password can reveal it.
create.add_something: Add text or at least one attachment to encrypt.

about.title: About Nyanbin
about.lead: Nyanbin shares text and files as authenticated encrypted envelopes with bounded lifecycles.
about.how_body: The browser encrypts the note, format, filenames, MIME hints, sizes, and bytes. The server sees the note ID, protocol version, encrypted length, expiry, and optional read cap. The link secret stays in the URL fragment.
about.limits_body: Anyone with the complete link and optional password can reveal the note. A malicious server could replace the web application, and traffic timing or ciphertext length remains visible. Use HTTPS and a trusted deployment.
about.origin_body: Nyanbin is built from Cryptgeon's MIT-licensed foundation and reimplements selected privacy and product ideas studied in PrivateBin. Its interface and cat artwork are original.
about.instance_default: This is a self-hosted Nyanbin instance.
